# wave 12 — the [MISSING]-block frontier on the campaign's path.
#
# tools/harvest_missing_blocks.py found 73,487 __remill_missing_block targets in
# the lifted IR, 53,094 of them not registered as entry points. Lifting all of
# them is ~7h and an enormous binary, and almost all are on paths nothing ever
# executes. These are the ones inside the functions the campaign demonstrably
# runs: the GSC VM fetch/dispatch region 0x87f000..0x884000 (where a script
# error's longjmp lands — see the 0x883679 fix), the gump worker 0x852ad0, and
# the frames of the tid-12 chain from the deadlock dump.
